replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
I'm not for the emojis, but we shouldn't deny a suggestion just because other things are more important.
It's like denying an amazing map just because the map developers are making a hub.

As I said I'm not in favor of this, because I like how clean the forums are looking. It's simple and in some way minimalistic (is that a word?). I think Emojis in the titles would kind of destroy that.
